reviews.comment: One of the greatest teachers I have ever had. Professor Kun helped me learn conceptual terms & made it simple to understand. She will be an inspiration for all of her future students. Thank you for everything.
Would recommend her to any prospective student.

Professor Chang is a great professor! There is alot of reading but I learned so much in this class. The professor keeps the class exciting, is easy to understrand and has a lot of useful information. Hopefully I have more of her classes.

reviews.comment: I took a class with Kun Chang, she is one of the best teachers that I have ever had. Her course was interesting and though provoking. It is indeed a challenging course but to be expected from a high level professor. I would love to have more classes with Kun! Kun keeps the class intersted and is very intelligent on the subject. Thank you so much.

Textbook is a $0.99 store self-help book. Super conceptual and vague terms. Grades are out of 100 total points, no extra credit, no rounding-up on final grades. Each point that you don't get on an assignment or exam kills your grade because they are worth so much. Good luck getting clear answers to questions in emails. Why is this a course?!
